exposure: Any complications during the pregnancy period
outcome: Clinical phenotypes of individuals with a first episode of psychosis (FEP)
Severity of psychopathology (measured by Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale for schizophrenia)
cohort: 277 patients experiencing a first episode of psychosis (FEP) were assessed.
finding: Total obstetric complications and difficulties in delivery were significantly related to more severe psychopathology in patients with a first episode of psychosis.
mod_finding: Difficulties in delivery were related to more severe psychopathology.
cross-section timing: At the time of a first episode of psychosis (FEP) diagnosis.
